classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary motion concerning Switzerland's contribution to reparations for the consequences of slavery in Haiti, presented by Josef Lang and debated in the National Council on 28 February 2011. The motion was recorded as part of the National Council's video archive during the spring session of 2011. It captures a formal legislative discussion involving Micheline Calmy-Rey and Josef Lang.
